records.jp: 有理……
records.en_original: Yuri...
records.en_auxiliary: Yuri...

records.jp: んん……
records.en_original: Nngh...
records.en_auxiliary: Nngh...

records.jp: ん……私は……
records.en_original: Nn... What...happened?
records.en_auxiliary: Ngh... What...happened?

records.jp: よかったぁ……。心配したよ……
records.en_original: I'm glad you're up. I was so worried about you...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm glad you're up. I was so worried about you...

records.jp: 大丈夫だったみたいだね！
records.en_original: But it seems like you're alright!
records.en_auxiliary: But it seems like you're all right!

records.jp: ユズ。ライム
records.en_original: Hey, you two.
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, you two.

records.jp: 君たちは……。なぜここに？
records.en_original: Why...are you here?
records.en_auxiliary: Why are you here?
records.en: You two... Why are you here?

records.jp: なんだ、本当に何もないのね。<CR>もしかして、感情がないのかしら
records.en_original: Huh, I don't feel a thing. Maybe she doesn't have any emotions...
records.en_auxiliary: Huh, I don't feel a thing. Maybe she doesn't have any emotions...
records.en: Huh. There really is nothing.<CR>Could it be that you have no emotions?

records.jp: ……だとしたらどうだというんだ？
records.en_original: ...Is it a problem if I don't?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Is it a problem if I don't?
records.en: ...And if that is true, what of it?

records.jp: ……残念。煽ればいけるかと思ったけど、<CR>これじゃフラグメントは出来なさそう
records.en_original: ...It's kind of a shame. I thought we might be able to acquire a Fragment by shaking you up a bit.
records.en_auxiliary: ...It's kind of a shame. I thought we might be able to acquire a Fragment by shaking you up a bit.
records.en: ...Too bad. I thought provoking you might work,<CR>but it doesn't look like a Fragment will form this way.

records.jp: ライム！
records.en_original: Lime!
records.en_auxiliary: Lime!

records.jp: ……何の話だ？　フラグメント……？
records.en_original: ...What are you talking about? Did you say, "Fragment"?
records.en_auxiliary: ...What is she talking about? What's a "Fragment"?
records.en: ...What are you talking about? Did you say, "Fragment"?

records.jp: 話すよ、全部。<CR>何が起こっているのか――
records.en_original: I'll tell you everything. It's a long story, though, so bear with me...
records.en_auxiliary: I'll tell you everything. It's a long story, though, so bear with me...
records.en: I'll tell you everything.<CR>About what's happening—

records.jp: ……なるほど。そんなことになっていたとは
records.en_original: Interesting. So that's what's going on.
records.en_auxiliary: Interesting. So that's what's going on.
records.en: I see. So that is what was happening.

records.jp: 信じるの？
records.en_original: Wait, you actually believe us?
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, you actually believe me?

records.jp: ああ。私の研究結果と照らし合わせても辻褄が合う。<CR>欠けていたピースがぴったりはまった気分だ
records.en_original: I do. Your story's consistent with my research results. You've provided me with the missing piece of the puzzle.
records.en_auxiliary: I do. Your story's consistent with my research results. You've provided me with the missing piece of the puzzle.
records.en: Yes. It is consistent with my research results.<CR>It feels as though a missing piece has fallen perfectly into place.

records.jp: 聞かせてくれないか。私の心はどうなっていたのか。<CR>どんな感情を示していたかを
records.en_original: But please, tell me. What has become of my heart? What emotions did you see?
records.en_auxiliary: But please, tell me. What has become of my heart? What emotions did you see?
records.en: Would you tell me what my heart was like?<CR>What emotions was it showing?

records.jp: それは……
……そうか、やはり何もなかったんだな
records.en_original: ...So there was nothing. I see.
records.en_auxiliary: ...So there was nothing. I see.

records.jp: ご、ごめん……
records.en_original: I'm sorry...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry...

records.jp: 君が謝る必要はない
records.en_original: There's no need for you to apologize.
records.en_auxiliary: There's no need for you to apologize.
records.en: There's no need for you to apologize.

records.jp: 感情のあるなしは私の問題であって、<CR>君の行為の結果ではないのだから
records.en_original: My lack of emotions is my problem, not a result of your actions.
records.en_auxiliary: My lack of emotions is my problem, not a result of your actions.
records.en: Whether I possess emotions is my problem,<CR>not the result of anything you did.

records.jp: しかし……そうか。<CR>こうしてみると少し期待していたんだとわかるな
records.en_original: Although... No. I think I might have been a little overly hopeful.
records.en_auxiliary: Although... I suppose I was a little hopeful.
records.en: Still...I see.<CR>Judging by my reaction, I realize I had been hoping for something.

records.jp: 出自は多少、異常でも<CR>ひと欠片くらい人間らしい心が残っていたのではと
records.en_original: Even with my condition, I had hoped there would have been at least a sliver of human emotion in my heart.
records.en_auxiliary: Even with my condition, I had hoped there would have been at least a sliver of human emotion in my heart.
records.en: Even if the way I came to be was somewhat abnormal,<CR>I hoped at least a fragment of a human heart remained.

records.jp: 結果はこれだ
records.en_original: But the results speak for themselves.
records.en_auxiliary: But the results speak for themselves.

records.jp: なんの彩りも温もりもない、<CR>後付けのプログラムでできあがった人格
records.en_original: No warmth, no color, just the retrofit program that is my personality.
records.en_auxiliary: No warmth, no color—just the retrofit program that is my personality.
records.en: A personality with no color or warmth,<CR>assembled from programs installed after the fact.

records.jp: 斎木有理という個人には何もない。<CR>ただのがらんどう……虚無だ
records.en_original: The individual known as Yuri Saiki doesn't exist. <CR>I'm just an empty void in the shape of a person.
records.en_auxiliary: The individual known as Yuri Saiki doesn't exist.<CR>I'm just an empty void in the shape of a person.
records.en: There is nothing within the individual called Saiki Yuri.<CR>I am merely an empty shell...a void.

records.jp: そんなこと……！
records.en_original: Don't say that!
records.en_auxiliary: Don't say that!

records.jp: どうしたの？　ヒナちゃん
records.en_original: Are you okay, Hina?
records.en_auxiliary: What's the matter, Hina?

records.jp: 違う
records.en_original: No, I'm not okay!
records.en_auxiliary: You're wrong.

records.jp: 違うよ、有理！
records.en_original: You're wrong, Yuri!
records.en_auxiliary: You're wrong, Yuri!

records.jp: な、何がだ
records.en_original: In what regard?
records.en_auxiliary: In what regard?

records.jp: 思い出して、有理。<CR>さっき『心がないかも』って聞いた時、あなたなんて言った？
records.en_original: Think, Yuri. When you learned we didn't see your emotions in the Common, what did you say?
records.en_auxiliary: Think, Yuri. When you learned we didn't see your emotions in the Common, what did you say?
records.en: Think back, Yuri.<CR>When I asked whether you might have no heart, what did you say?

records.jp: 何って、だからがらんどうだと……
records.en_original: That I was an empty void.
records.en_auxiliary: That I was an empty void.

records.jp: 違う、その前！
records.en_original: No, before that!
records.en_auxiliary: No, before that!

records.en_original: Before...
records.en_auxiliary: Before...

records.jp: 有理は『期待してた』って言ったんだよ
records.en_original: Yuri, you said you were hopeful.
records.en_auxiliary: Yuri, you said you were hopeful.

records.jp: 心がない人が「期待」なんてするの？
records.en_original: Can someone without emotions have hope?
records.en_auxiliary: Can someone without emotions have hope?
records.en: Would someone without a heart be able to hope?

records.jp: もし、本当に有理に心がないのなら、<CR>ないことを疑問にも思わないはず
records.en_original: And Yuri, if you really didn't have emotions, you wouldn't have batted an eye when you heard we didn't see any.
records.en_auxiliary: And Yuri, if you really didn't have emotions, you wouldn't have batted an eye when you heard we didn't see any.
records.en: If you truly had no heart,<CR>you would not question its absence.

records.jp: それに有理、さっきからすごく悲しそう。<CR>辛くて胸が張り裂けそうな顔をしてる
records.en_original: But from the moment you heard, you've looked so sad, like your heart was breaking.
records.en_auxiliary: But from the moment you heard, you've looked so sad, like your heart was breaking.
records.en: And you have looked terribly sad this whole time, Yuri.<CR>You look as if the pain might tear your heart apart.

records.jp: ……それは
records.en_original: ...That's--
records.en_auxiliary: That's—

records.jp: 有理はきっと恐れてる。<CR>自分自身が不完全だって言われることを
records.en_original: Yuri, you're just afraid. You're afraid of being told that you're an incomplete human being.
records.en_auxiliary: Yuri, you're just afraid. You're afraid of being told that you're an incomplete human being.
records.en: I think you are afraid, Yuri.<CR>Afraid someone will tell you that you are incomplete.

records.jp: でも恐怖だって悲しみだって立派な感情なんだよ？
records.en_original: But you're not. Fear, sadness -- they're both wonderfully human emotions.
records.en_auxiliary: But you're not. Fear, sadness—they're both wonderfully human emotions.
records.en: But fear and sadness are real emotions too, you know?

records.jp: 何度だって言うよ。<CR>本当に有理に心がないのなら、そのことを疑問にも思わないはず
records.en_original: I'll tell you however many times it takes. If you, Yuri, didn't have any emotion, you wouldn't question that fact.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll tell you however many times it takes. If you, Yuri, didn't have any emotions, you wouldn't have questioned it.
records.en: I'll say it as many times as I have to.<CR>If you truly had no heart, you wouldn't question whether you had one.

records.jp: 疑問に思っている時点で、それは有理に心があることの証明。<CR>違う？
records.en_original: But the moment you question whether you have emotions is the very moment you prove that you do. Am I wrong?
records.en_auxiliary: But the fact that you questioned whether you have emotions proves that you do. Am I wrong?
records.en: The fact that you do question it proves you have a heart.<CR>Am I wrong?

records.jp: Cogito ergo sum……
records.en_original: Cogito ergo sum...
records.en_auxiliary: Cogito, ergo sum...

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Sorry?
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry?

records.jp: 我思う、故に我あり……だ。<CR>ふむ、なるほどな
records.en_original: I think, therefore I am... Hmm. I never gave that much thought until now.
records.en_auxiliary: I think, therefore I am.<CR>Hmm, so that's how it is.
records.en: I think, therefore I am...<CR>Hmm. I see.

records.jp: 確かに今日、君と過ごした時間はとても興味深いものだった。<CR>そう、今までになく……
records.en_original: The time I spent with you today was fascinating. I can't say I've ever experienced anything like it.
records.en_auxiliary: The time I spent with you today was fascinating. I can't say I've ever experienced anything like it.
records.en: The time I spent with you today was indeed fascinating.<CR>Yes...unlike anything before.

records.jp: これが“悲しい”、これが“苦しい”。<CR>そして
records.en_original: So this is "sorrow," and this is "agony"... <CR>And...
records.en_auxiliary: So this is "sorrow," and this is "agony"...<CR>And...

records.jp: 君と一緒に紡いだ記憶……。<CR>ああ……そうか、これが“楽しい”という感情か
records.en_original: The memory of our time together... <CR>Must be "joy."
records.en_auxiliary: The memory of our time together...<CR>This must be "joy."
records.en: The memories I wove together with you...<CR>Ah...I see. So this is what "fun" feels like.

records.jp: あっ……！
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?!

records.jp: これって……！
records.en_original: What the--
records.en_auxiliary: What the—

records.jp: えっ？　どうしたの！？
records.en_original: Eh? What's wrong!?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? What's going on?

records.jp: 感じない？　ゆりっちから感情が溢れてくる！<CR>まるで、スイッチが入ったみたいに……！
records.en_original: Can't you feel it? The emotions welling up inside Yuricchi! It's like a switch has been turned on...!
records.en_auxiliary: Can't you feel it? Emotions are welling up inside Yuricchi! It's like a switch was flipped!
records.en: Can't you feel it? Emotions are overflowing from Yuricchi!<CR>It's as though a switch has been flipped...!

records.jp: 間違いないよ、フラグメントが出現してる！
records.en_original: No doubt about it, there's a Fragment emerging!
records.en_auxiliary: No doubt about it, there's a Fragment emerging!
records.en: No doubt about it—a Fragment is appearing!

records.jp: こんなことが……
records.en_original: Is that even possible?
records.en_auxiliary: Is that even possible?

records.jp: これが……私の
records.en_original: So this is my...
records.en_auxiliary: This is my...

records.en_original: Whoa...
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa...

records.jp: 今……もしかして、何かしたのか？
records.en_original: Did you...do something just now?
records.en_auxiliary: Did you...do something just now?

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: I did.
records.en_auxiliary: I did.

records.jp: そうか……。自分ではあまり実感もないが
records.en_original: I see... Well, given that I have no feelings of my own...
records.en_auxiliary: I see... Well, given that I have no feelings of my own...
records.en: I see... I do not feel much of a change myself.

records.jp: やっぱり有理は気づいてなかっただけだよ。<CR>本当は前からずっと悩んだり喜んだりしてたんだと思う
records.en_original: You might not have noticed, but you were worrying and feeling joy this whole time.
records.en_auxiliary: You might not have noticed, but you were worrying and feeling joy this whole time.
records.en: You just hadn't noticed, Yuri.<CR>I think you've been worrying and feeling joy all along.

records.jp: 自分の感情がどういうものか、つかめてなかっただけで
records.en_original: I just think you didn't understand them before.
records.en_auxiliary: I just think you didn't understand them before.
records.en: You just didn't know how to recognize your own emotions.

records.jp: だから……
records.en_original: So...
records.en_auxiliary: So...

records.jp: わからないことがあったらいつでも連絡してよ。<CR>相談に乗るから
records.en_original: If there's ever anything you don't understand, you can talk to me any time. We'll figure things out.
records.en_auxiliary: If there's ever anything you don't understand, you can talk to me any time. We'll figure things out.
records.en: Whenever there's something you don't understand, just contact me.<CR>I'll help you work through it.

records.jp: 私たちは『友達』だよね？
records.en_original: Because we're friends. That's what we do.
records.en_auxiliary: Because we're friends. That's what we do.

records.jp: 承知した。<CR>存分に頼らせてもらうとしよう
records.en_original: Understood. You'll be the first person I contact.
records.en_auxiliary: Understood. You'll be the first person I contact.
records.en: Understood.<CR>Then I shall rely on you to my heart's content.
